utterance: The `app-vpc` VPC (10.0.0.0/16) is the storefront application's network. Give the application two subnets in it, one in us-east-1a and one in us-east-1b, and create an EC2 instance in each subnet: the latest Amazon Linux 2 AMI, instance type t2.micro, and an attached EBS volume of 50 GB.

main.responsibility: owns the application's resources and their configuration
main.intent: the app-vpc VPC holds two new subnets, one in us-east-1a and one in us-east-1b, each with a CIDR block of its own inside 10.0.0.0/16, and each of those two subnets runs one new EC2 instance of type t2.micro launched from the latest Amazon Linux 2 AMI with a 50 GB EBS root volume
